RESTART is the decided return entry (r6-program.mjs:49), not a capacity estimate: calibration goes EFFORT_ONLY (MODE_WALK_JOG_RESTART_RETURN). The cost is under-dosing for training outside the record, which is not a safety cost.

Narrowest reading: CORRECTION_CONFLICTS_WITH_A_REPORT_IN_FORCE, 2+ parts, every voice did. A direct conflict, a not-done voice or a single voice is not shown (A12, B4, B5, B7, C7). Amount 0 is the normalizer's quarantine value and never exceeds the lowest value at the bound. P4 alone: zero gives RESTART at 45 in week 0; the lowest value (5 min/week) gives WALK_JOG at 60.

Section 4 is reproduced end to end. One consequence is unlisted: the shorter pause lifts the C-Q08-2 return floor (six executions 12-27 d plus P4 at 3 d: base RESTART 45; candidate EASY_CURRENT 80/80/80/104, identical to the in-force 20-minute control incl. calibration).
